correctness.rationale: The proof reduces all possible zeros to a complete frequency split. Nonzero even frequencies have odd character order and cannot contain an antipodal pair; \(k=p\) is exactly the parity-balance test; every other odd \(k\) is a unit modulo \(2p\), so four-term cancellation is equivalent to the original set being a union of two antipodal pairs. The three classes are exhaustive and disjoint, and their counts follow from choosing parity classes and antipodal orbits. Exact cyclotomic replay on 23,491 subsets and 565,834 frequencies corroborates the proof.
